title: Sounds solid
html_source: Suggests his experiment has found an object which exists – something outwith the mind: Berkeley’s incorrect, though he implies an uncertainty about the conclusion- it only sounds solid!

anchor.prefix: einander ineluctably! I am getting on nicely in the dark. My ash sword hangs at my side. Tap with it: they do. My two feet in his boots are at the ends of his legs, nebeneinander.
anchor.suffix:
: made by the mallet of Los Demiurgos. Am I walking into eternity along Sandymount strand? Crush, crack, crick, crick. Wild sea money. Dominie Deasy kens them a'.
